prompt: Load 1HK0 and add a ball-and-stick representation for Phe116, in element colours. Then, keeping it, add a spacefill representation for Val170 as well. Do not recolour anything.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 2 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
changing the colour of a call whose colouring a later call replaces changes nothing and still succeeds
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.6667)
equivalent answer succeeds: one call with both residues
wrong answer fails: two calls without keep_representations (the first representation is removed) (F1 0.6667)
wrong answer fails: no color key (the residues turn the default orange) (F1 0.75)
provenance.derived: Two seeded residues as in api-residue-colour, each given an added representation in its own `color` call. A second call removes the representations the first one added unless keep_representations is set.
